# MacBook Repair Dubai

> MacBook Repair Dubai is an independent Apple repair specialist in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, in business since 10 October 2004. The workshop is Mac-first (MacBook Air, MacBook Pro, iMac, Mac mini, Mac Studio and Mac Pro, down to board level) and also repairs iPhone and iPad. Walk in at Office #45, 10th Floor, Concord Tower, Al Sufouh, Dubai Media City, or book a free pickup in Dubai. Repair quotes are given on WhatsApp at +971 55 741 3706.

MacBook Repair Dubai is not an Apple Authorised Service Provider and is not affiliated with Apple Inc.

Diagnosis is free. Repair prices are not published on the site: every repair is quoted on WhatsApp (https://wa.me/971557413706) once the model and fault are known, before any work starts.

Opening hours (Dubai time): Monday to Saturday: 9 am - 10 pm; Sunday: closed. Google rating: 5.0 from 232+ reviews. Written warranty up to 12 months, depending on the repair.

Not offered in-house: Apple Watch, AirPods, Apple TV and HomePod repair.

Generated 2026-09-27 from the site's route table and business settings. 630 public pages are listed below; the long-form version with business facts is at https://macbook-repair-dubai.ae/llms-full.txt
